grants.n: The Grantee will deliver a range of Area Switch projects to change the existing local telecommunications infrastructure throughout Australia.

The Grantee will provide new and upgraded mobile voice and data services in specified regional, rural and remote locations, using a combination of brownfield and greenfield sites and upgrades to existing fibre networks and backhaul.
The Commonwealth has made Funding available through Round 7 of the Mobile Black Spot Program (the Program) with the aim of extending mobile coverage in identified underserved areas of Australia.
The Commonwealth has made Funding available through Round 7 of the Mobile Black Spot Program (the Program) with the aim of extending mobile coverage in identified underserved areas of Australia.

The Grantee will provide broadband Wi-Fi internet and telephone connectivity, including free Wi-Fi connectivity, to specified remote indigenous communities of Northern Queensland and Western Australia.
The Grantee will provide Fixed Wireless coverage at 36 specified sites across the Wheatbelt region of Western Australia.

The project will provide 11km of optical fibre connecting the town of Batchelor at key sites including council building, museum, school, community health centre and the Batchelor Institute of Indigenous Tertiary Education

The Grantee has been awarded this Grant under the Program for two projects which will deliver a 11km overhead optical fibre extension linking Tullah and a 29km optical fibre extension linking Zeehan to the Grantee's existing network in Tasmania.

The Grantee will deliver five projects providing Wi-Fi and fixed wireless services to communities in Alice Springs and in the Central Desert Region, as well as upgrade existing services at a number of town camps to increase reliability.
The Grantee will provide fixed wireless connectivity, including limited free public wi-fi access at specified sites of North West Queensland.
The grantee will provide fixed wireless broadband at specified sites in New South Wales.
The Grantee will deliver fixed wireless and mobile broadband, including satellite backhaul, to agricultural areas of Weddin Shire in New South Wales.
The Grantee will provide upgraded existing Fixed Wireless network and backhaul links to increase capacity and speeds in areas across southern NSW.
The Grantee will deliver Fixed Wireless broadband, backhauled via satellite. Providing coverage to Norfolk Island's residents.
